<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Reopen the Project in the Dev Container</span>:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">With the project open in VS Code, press Ctrl+Shift+P (Cmd+Shift+P on macOS) to open the Command Palette.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Type and select <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Dev Containers: Reopen in Container</span>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">VS Code will build/pull the container (first time may take several minutes).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Once complete, VS Code reloads inside the container (“[Dev Container]” in the status bar).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Verify the Environment</span>:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Open a new terminal in VS Code (Terminal &gt; New Terminal).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">The prompt may show <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">(base)</code> if so activate the custom environment with <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">conda activate cs6035_ML</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Run <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">conda env list</code> to confirm <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">cs6035_ML</code> exists and is active.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Set Up Python Interpreter and Tests</span>:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Follow the same steps as in the <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://github.gatech.edu/pages/cs6035-tools/cs6035-tools.github.io/Projects/Machine_Learning/setup.html#vs-code-specific-instructions">VS Code-Specific Instructions</a> section:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Use Ctrl+Shift+P &gt; <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Python: Select Interpreter</span> and choose the Python interpreter from the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">cs6035_ML</code> environment (typically under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">/opt/conda/envs/cs6035_ML/bin/python</code>).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Configure tests: Click the beaker icon in the sidebar, then “Configure Tests” &gt; Select <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">unittest</code> &gt; <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">tests</code> directory &gt; <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_*.py</code> pattern.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Tests should now appear in the Testing sidebar, and you can run/debug them.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Troubleshooting</span>:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Build Failures</span>: Network/timeout issues during Conda create? The <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">postCreateCommand</code> already includes a higher timeout; rebuild if needed (Command Palette &gt; <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Dev Containers: Rebuild Container</span>).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Podman-specific errors</span>: Check socket (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">podman system connection default</code>), rootless UID mapping, or try rootful mode temporarily.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Performance</span>: On macOS/Windows, allocate more resources to Docker Desktop/Podman machine in settings.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">For advanced customization, see the official Dev Containers docs: <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/devcontainers/containers">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/devcontainers/containers</a>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="project-installation-on-the-vm" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;">Project Installation on the VM</h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">VM Installation Instructions</span>

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">On the VM we provide a one-step script to set up the project. It will download and install Miniconda and the cs6035_ML environment, as well as downloading and unzipping the project’s Student_Local_Testing directory.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Open the vm and login to the <code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">machine</code> user account with the password provided in Canvas.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Open a terminal window in the VM.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">On the Lubuntu VM you click the bird icon in the lower left corner, choose System, and the choose Terminal (or QTerminal – both work!).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">On the newer Ubuntu VM for Fall 24, click Activities in the upper left corner and enter Terminal into the search box that appears. The Terminal app will appear.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Enter the following command on one line:<br style="box-sizing: border-box;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">wget https://cs6035.s3.amazonaws.com/ML/setup_conda_and_project.sh</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">This command will download the <code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">setup_conda_and_project.sh</code> script.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">You need to make the script executable, enter the following command:<br style="box-sizing: border-box;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">chmod +x setup_conda_and_project.sh</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Now that you have made the script executable, you need to run it like this:</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">./setup_conda_and_project.sh</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">This will run for a while, if it times out, edit the script and increase the value on this line:<br style="box-sizing: border-box;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">/home/machine/miniconda3/bin/conda config --set remote_read_timeout_secs 180.0</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Once this script finishes, you will need to open a new terminal window to pick up on the newly installed environment. The easiest way to do this is to close and re-open the terminal application.</li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Running VS Code or PyCharm Community on the VM:</span>

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">We have provided scripts in your home directory to install PyCharm or VS Code on the VM.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">To install these IDEs, run either:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">VS Code:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">wget -O vscode_portable.tar.gz "https://code.visualstudio.com/sha/download?build=stable&amp;os=linux-x64"</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">tar -xzvf vscode_portable.tar.gz</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">cd VSCode-Linux-x64</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">./code</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Pycharm
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Go to Pycharm and determine the latest version to download: https://www.jetbrains.com/pycharm/download/?section=linux#section=linux</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Then unpack the tar <code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">tar -xvzf pycharm-2026.1.tar</code> [replacing the 2026.1 with whatever version is the latest at the time you download it]</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">cd pycharm-community-2021.3.2/bin/</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">chmod u+x pycharm.sh</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">./pycharm.sh</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Follow the IDE Setup instructions for either IDE, as described above in the host section.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">The IDE should now be installed if you look at the menu in the bottom left corner of the Desktop (or also accessible via command line if you’re familiar with that)</li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><img data-recalc-dims="1" style="box-sizing: border-box; border-style: none;" src="https://i0.wp.com/github.gatech.edu/pages/cs6035-tools/cs6035-tools.github.io/Projects/Machine_Learning/images/ML-setup-open-IDE.png?w=980&amp;ssl=1" alt="Image of Start Bar Dialog">

<h2 id="project-installation-on-proxmox" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;">Project Installation on Proxmox</h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">If you have access to a <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://www.proxmox.com/en/proxmox-virtual-environment/overview">Proxmox VE</a> server, you can import the course-provided OVA directly rather than using the standard VM download. These instructions were contributed by a previous student and if you have suggestions for improvements please let us know in a private Ed Post.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Prerequisites:</span> A running Proxmox VE instance with SSH/terminal access and access to the Proxmox web GUI.

<h3 id="step-1--download-the-ova" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 1 — Download the OVA</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Find the current semester’s VM OVA download link and SHA256 hash posted on Ed Discussion. Download the OVA ideally directly onto your Proxmox machine. A convenient storage location on Proxmox is alongside other ISOs:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; background-color: #f5f6fa; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: none; position: relative; padding: 0px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<div class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">/var/lib/vz/template/iso/
</code></pre>
</div>
&nbsp;

</div>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Verify the downloaded file matches the SHA256 hash provided on Ed Discussion before proceeding.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">If you downloaded it on your laptop first, SCP it to your Proxmox machine:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; background-color: #f5f6fa; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: none; position: relative; padding: 0px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<div class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">scp &lt;your-ova-file&gt;.ova root@&lt;proxmox-ip&gt;:/var/lib/vz/template/iso/
</code></pre>
</div>
&nbsp;

</div>
<h3 id="step-2--extract-the-vmdk-from-the-ova" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 2 — Extract the VMDK from the OVA</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">In a Proxmox terminal, navigate to where you saved the OVA and extract it:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; background-color: #f5f6fa; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: none; position: relative; padding: 0px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<div class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><span class="nb" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #ca7601;">tar</span> <span class="nt" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #e35549;">-xvf</span> &lt;your-ova-file&gt;.ova
</code></pre>
</div>
&nbsp;

</div>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">This will produce a <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">.vmdk</code> file (and possibly some <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">.ovf</code>/<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">.mf</code> files). Note the exact <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">.vmdk</code> filename — you will need it in Step 4.

<h3 id="step-3--create-a-vm-shell-in-the-proxmox-gui" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 3 — Create a VM shell in the Proxmox GUI</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">In the Proxmox web GUI, click <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Create VM</span> and configure it as follows:

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">General</span>: Give the VM a name.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">OS</span>: Select <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Do not use any media</span> (you will attach the VMDK instead).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Disks</span>: <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Delete the default <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; font-weight: 400; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">scsi0</code> disk</span> that Proxmox creates (you will import the VMDK instead).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Everything else</span>: Use the defaults or adjust CPU/RAM to your preference.</li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Note the <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">VM ID</span> that Proxmox assigns (visible in the left sidebar, e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">100</code>).

<h3 id="step-4--import-the-vmdk-into-the-vm" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 4 — Import the VMDK into the VM</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Back in the Proxmox terminal, import the disk into your VM shell. This may take a few minutes:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; background-color: #f5f6fa; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: none; position: relative; padding: 0px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<div class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;">qm importdisk &lt;VM_ID&gt; &lt;extracted-file.vmdk&gt; &lt;storage_name&gt;
</code></pre>
</div>
&nbsp;

</div>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Replace <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">&lt;VM_ID&gt;</code> with the ID from Step 3 (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">100</code>).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Replace <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">&lt;extracted-file.vmdk&gt;</code> with the actual filename from Step 2.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Replace <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">&lt;storage_name&gt;</code> with your Proxmox storage (commonly <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">local-lvm</code>). Run <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">pvesm status</code> to see your available storage names.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="step-5--attach-the-disk-and-boot" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 5 — Attach the disk and boot</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">In the Proxmox GUI, select your VM and make these changes:

<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: none; counter-reset: step-counter 0; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Hardware</span> → double-click <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Unused Disk 0</span> → click <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Add</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Options</span> → <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Boot Order</span> → move your disk to the top (uncheck all other entries)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Click <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Start</span> to boot the VM</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="step-6--log-in-and-set-up-the-project" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Step 6 — Log in and set up the project</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Once the VM boots, log in with:

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">

<h2 id="task-1-15--points" style="letter-spacing: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5rem 0px 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 36px !important;" class="akch-demoted-h1">Task 1 (15 points)</h2>
<hr style="box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">For the first task, let’s get familiar with some pandas basics. pandas is a Python library that deals with DataFrames, which you can think of as a Python class that handles tabular data. In the real world, you would create graphics and other visuals to better understand the dataset you are working with. You would also use plotting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Data Studio, and Matplotlib. This step is generally known as exploratory data analysis. Since we are using an autograder for this class, we will skip the plotting for this project.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">For this task, we have released a local test suite. If you are struggling to understand the expected inputs and outputs for a function, please set up the test suite and use it to debug your function. Please note that the return lines for the provided skeleton functions are placeholders for the data types that the tests expect.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">It’s critical you pass all tests locally before you submit to Gradescope for credit. Do not use Gradescope for debugging.</span>

<hr style="box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Theory</span>

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">In this task, we’re not yet getting into theory. It’s more nuts and bolts – you will learn the basics of pandas. pandas DataFrames are something of a glorified list of lists, mixed in with a dictionary. You get a table of values with rows and columns, and you can modify the column names and index values for the rows. There are numerous functions built into pandas to let you manipulate the data in the DataFrame.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">To be clear, pandas is not part of Python, so when you look up docs, you’ll specifically want <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/index.html">the official Pydata pandas docs</a>. Note that we linked to the API docs here, this is the core of the docs you’ll be looking at.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">You can always get started trying to solve a problem by looking at Stack Overflow posts in Google search results. There you’ll find ideas about how to use the pandas library. In the end, however, you should find yourself in the habit of looking directly at the docs for whichever library you are using, pandas in this case.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">For those who might need a concrete example to get started, here’s how you would take a pandas dataframe column and return the average of its values:

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Now that we have created a dataframe, we can find the average weight by summing the values under ‘weight’ and dividing them by the sum:

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Explaination</span> Reviewing the link in the Useful Resource we can see pandas has a <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">DataFrame.sample</code> method that can be used to sample from a pd.DataFrame Class and returns a pd.DataFrame class. The task Description mentions that you will use <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">random_state</code> to return the expected pd.DataFrame object looking at the method it also uses the same naming scheme for those variables so we can use the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">dataset</code> variable (which is a pd.DataFrame), the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">DataFrame.sample</code> method and the input parameters passed into our skeleton to return the expected result. <h2 id="find_dataset_statistics" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">find_dataset_statistics</code></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">Now that you have learned a bit about pandas DataFrames, we will use them to generate some simple summary statistics for a DataFrame. You will be given the dataset as an input variable, as well as a column name for a column in the dataset that serves as a label column. This label column contains binary values (0 and 1) that you also summarize, and also the variable to predict.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">In this context:

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">0 represents a “negative” sample (e.g. if the column is IsAVirus and we think it is false)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">1 represents a “positive” sample (e.g. if the column is IsAVirus and we think it is true)</li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; color: #000000 !important;">This type of binary classification is common in machine learning tasks where we want to be able to predict the field. An example of where this could be useful would be if we were looking at network data, and the label column was <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">IsVirus</code>. We could then analyze the network data of Georgia Tech services and predict if incoming files look like a virus (and if we should alert the security team).

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<hr style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">Now that you have a basic understanding of pandas and the dataset, it is time to dive into some more complex data processing tasks.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<hr style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Theory</span>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">In machine learning a common goal is to train a model on one set of data. Then we validate the model on a similarly structured but different set of data. You could, for example, train the model on data you have collected historically. Then you would validate the model against real-time data as it comes in, seeing how well it predicts the new data coming in.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">If you’re looking at a past dataset as we are in these tasks, we need to treat different parts of the data differently to be able to develop and test models. We segregate the data into test and training portions. We train the model on the training data and test the developed model on the test data to see how well it predicts the results.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">You should never train your models on test data, only on training data.</span>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<hr style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<h2 id="notes" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;">Notes</h2>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">At a high level it is important to hold out a subset of your data when you train a model. You can see what the expected performance is on unseen sample. Thus, you can determine if the resulting model is overfit (performs much better on training data vs test data).

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">Preprocessing data is essential because most models only take in numerical values. Therefore, categorical features need to be “encoded” to numerical values so that models can use them. A machine learning model may not be able to make sense of “green”, “blue” and “red.” In preprocessing, we’ll convert those to integer values 1, 2 and 3, for example. It’s an interesting question as to what happens when you have training data that has “green,” “red” and blue,” but your testing data says “yellow.”

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">Numerical scaling can be more or less useful depending on the type of model used, but it is especially important in linear models. Numerical scaling is typically taking positive value and “compressing” them into a range between 0 and 1 (inclusive) that retains the relationships among the original data.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">These preprocessing techniques will provide you with options to augment your dataset and improve model performance.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<ul style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff;">

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

The first is splitting your dataset into both features and labels (by columns), and the second is splitting your dataset into training and test sets (by rows). You should use the scikit-learn <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_test_split</code> function but will have to write wrapper code around it based on the input values we give you.

</span>    <span class="k" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #a625a4;">return</span> <span class="n" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">train_features</span><span class="p" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">,</span><span class="n" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">test_features</span><span class="p" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">,</span><span class="n" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">train_labels</span><span class="p" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">,</span><span class="n" style="box-sizing: border-box; color: #383942;">test_labels</span>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<h2 id="preprocessdataset" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;">PreprocessDataset</h2>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">The PreprocessDataset Class contains a code skeleton with nine methods for you to implement. Most methods will be split into two parts: one that will be run on the training dataset and one that will be run on the test dataset. In Data Science/Machine Learning, this is done to avoid something called <em style="box-sizing: border-box;"><a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://machinelearningmastery.com/data-leakage-machine-learning/">Data Leakage</a></em>.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For this assignment, we don’t expect you to understand the nuances of the concept, but we will have you follow principles that will minimize the chances of it occurring. You will accomplish this by splitting data into training and test datasets and processing those datasets in slightly different ways.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">Generally, for everything you do in this project, and if you do any ML or Data Science work in the future, you should train/fit on the training data first, then predict/transform on the training and test data. That holds up for basic preprocessing steps like task 2 and for complex models like you will see in tasks 3 and 4.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For the purposes of this project, you should <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">never</span> train or fit on the test data (and more generally in any ML project) because your test data is expected to give you an understanding of how your model/predictions will perform on unseen data. If you fit even a preprocessing step to your test data, then you are either giving the model information about the test set it wouldn’t have about unseen data (if you combine train and test and fit to both), or you are providing a different preprocessing than the model is expecting (if you fit a different preprocessor to the test data), and your model would not be expected to perform well.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Note</span>: You should train/fit using the train dataset; then, once you have a fit encoder/scaler/pca/model instance, you can transform/predict on the training and test data.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">You will also notice that we are only preprocessing the Features and not the Labels. There are a few cases where preprocessing steps on labels may be helpful in modeling, but they are definitely more advanced and out of the scope of this introduction. Generally, you will not need to do any preprocessing to your labels beyond potentially encoding a string value (i.e., “Malware” or “Benign”) into an integer value (0 or 1), which is called <em style="box-sizing: border-box;"><a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.preprocessing.LabelEncoder.html#sklearn.preprocessing.LabelEncoder">Label Encoding</a></em>.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
