<h2 id="calculate_logistic_regression_metrics" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">calculate_logistic_regression_metrics</code></h2>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<blockquote style="font-style: normal; white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5em 0px 10px; margin-block-start: 0px; margin-inline-start: 0px; padding-left: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #eeebee; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Important Note on Feature Selection:</span> RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) should <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">ONLY</span> be used for Logistic Regression. Do NOT use RFE for any tree-based models (Decision Tree, Random Forest, or Gradient Boosting) – use their built-in feature importance values instead.

</blockquote>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">A logistic regression model is a simple and more explainable statistical model that can be used to estimate the probability of an event (<a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://www.statisticshowto.com/log-odds/">log-odds</a>). At a high level, a logistic regression model uses data in the training set to estimate a column’s weight in a linear approximation function. Conceptually this is similar to estimating <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">m</code> for each column in the line formula you probably know well from geometry: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">y = m*x + b</code>. If you are interested in learning more, <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Logistic_regression">you can read up on the math</a> behind how this works. For this project, we are more focused on showing you how to apply these models, so you can simply use a scikit-learn Logistic Regression model in your code.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For this task use scikit-learn’s LogisticRegression class and complete the following subtasks:

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<ul style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Train a Logistic Regression model (initialized using the kwargs passed into the function)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Predict scores for training and test datasets and calculate the 7 metrics listed below for the training and test datasets using predictions from the fit model. (All rounded to 4 decimal places)
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">accuracy</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">recall</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">precision</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">fscore</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false positive rate (fpr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false negative rate (fnr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Area Under the Curve of Receiver Operating Characteristics Curve (roc_auc)</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Use RFE to select the top <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n_feat_importance</code> features</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Train a Logistic Regression model using these selected features (initialized using the kwargs passed into the function)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Create a Feature Importance DataFrame from the model trained on the top <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n_feat_importance</code> features:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Use the top N features (where N is configured via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n_feat_importance</code> input variable) and sort <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">by absolute value</span> of the coefficient from biggest to smallest.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Make sure you use the same feature and importance column names as set in ModelMetrics in feat_name_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Feature</code>] and imp_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Importance</code>].</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Round the importances to 4 decimal places (<span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">do this step after you have sorted by Importance</span>)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Reset the index to 0-&gt;(N-1). You can do this the same way you did in task1.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<td style="box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 80px; padding: 0.25rem 1rem 0.75rem; border-left: 1px solid #eeebee; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: center; font-size: 14px !important; color: #000000 !important;">android.permission.INTERNET</td>
<td style="box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 80px; padding: 0.25rem 1rem 0.75rem; border-left: 1px solid #eeebee; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: center; font-size: 14px !important; color: #000000 !important;">-2.7991</td>

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<h2 id="calculate_decision_tree_metrics" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">calculate_decision_tree_metrics</code></h2>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<blockquote style="font-style: normal; white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5em 0px 10px; margin-block-start: 0px; margin-inline-start: 0px; padding-left: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #eeebee; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Important Note on Feature Selection:</span> RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) should <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">ONLY</span> be used for Logistic Regression. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Do NOT use RFE</span> for any tree-based models (Decision Tree, Random Forest, or Gradient Boosting). For tree-based models, use their built-in feature importance values instead.

</blockquote>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">A Decision Tree (DT) is a supervised learning algorithm used for both classification and regression tasks. It works by recursively splitting the data into subsets based on the feature that results in the best separation of classes, typically measured using <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Gini impurity</span> or <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">entropy</span>. Decision trees are interpretable, as the learned model can be visualized as a flowchart-like structure.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">If you are interested in learning more, <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decision_tree_learning">you can read up on the math</a> behind how decision trees work.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For this project, we are more focused on showing you how to apply these models, so you can simply use a scikit-learn DecisionTreeClassifier in your code.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For this task, use scikit-learn’s DecisionTreeClassifier class and complete the following subtasks:

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<ul style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Train a DT model (initialized using the kwargs passed into the function).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Predict scores for training and test datasets and calculate the 7 metrics listed below for the training and test datasets using predictions from the fit model. (All rounded to 4 decimal places)
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">accuracy</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">recall</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">precision</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">fscore</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false positive rate (fpr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false negative rate (fnr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Area Under the Curve of Receiver Operating Characteristics Curve (roc_auc)</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Create a Feature Importance DataFrame from the trained model:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Do Not Use RFE for feature selection</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Use the top N (where N is configured via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n_feat_importance</code> input variable) features selected by the built in method (sorted from biggest to smallest)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Make sure you use the same feature and importance column names as ModelMetrics shows in feat_name_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Feature</code>] and imp_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Importance</code>]</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Round the importances to 4 decimal places (<span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">do this step after you have sorted by Importance</span>)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Reset the index to 0-&gt;(N-1) you can do this the same way you did in task1</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">NOTE:</span> Make sure you use the predicted probabilities for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">roc_auc</code>.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<h5 id="inputs-2" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 14px !important;">INPUTS</h5>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">The first 4 are similar to the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">tts</code> function you created in Task 2:

<h2 id="calculate_gradient_boosting_metrics" style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">calculate_gradient_boosting_metrics</code></h2>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<blockquote style="font-style: normal; white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5em 0px 10px; margin-block-start: 0px; margin-inline-start: 0px; padding-left: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #eeebee; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Important Note on Feature Selection:</span> RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) should <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">ONLY</span> be used for Logistic Regression. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Do NOT use RFE</span> for any tree-based models (Decision Tree, Random Forest, or Gradient Boosting). For tree-based models, use their built-in feature importance values instead.

</blockquote>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">A Gradient Boosted model is more complex than the Naive and Logistic Regression models and similar in structure to a Decision Tree model. A Gradient Boosted model expands on the tree-based model by using its additional trees to predict the errors from the previous tree. For this project, we are more focused on showing you how to apply these models, so you can simply use the scikit-learn Gradient Boosted Model in your code.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">For this task use scikit-learn’s Gradient Boosting Classifier class and complete the following subtasks:

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<ul style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px; color: #5c5962; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Train a Gradient Boosted model (initialized using the kwargs passed into the function)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Predict scores for training and test datasets and calculate the 7 metrics listed below for the training and test datasets using predictions from the fit model. (All rounded to 4 decimal places)
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">accuracy</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">recall</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">precision</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">fscore</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false positive rate (fpr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">false negative rate (fnr)</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Area Under the Curve of Receiver Operating Characteristics Curve (roc_auc)</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Create a Feature Importance DataFrame from the trained model:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Do Not Use RFE for feature selection</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Use the top N (where N is configured via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">n_feat_importance</code> input variable) features selected by the built in method (sorted from biggest to smallest)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Make sure you use the same feature and importance column names as ModelMetrics shows in feat_name_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Feature</code>] and imp_col [<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">Importance</code>]</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Round the importances to 4 decimal places (<span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">do this step after you have sorted by Importance</span>)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Reset the index to 0-&gt;(N-1). You can do this the same way you did in Task 1.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">NOTE:</span> Make sure you use the predicted probabilities for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">roc_auc</code>.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>
<p style="white-space: normal; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, blinkmacsystemfont, 'Segoe UI', roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000 !important;">Refer to the <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://github.gatech.edu/pages/cs6035-tools/cs6035-tools.github.io/Projects/Machine_Learning/submissions.html">Submissions</a> page for details about submitting your work.

<pre class="highlight" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: monospace, monospace; font-size: 1em; margin: 0px; background: #f5f6fa; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; padding: 0px; border: 0px;"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding: 0px; border: 0px; color: #000000 !important;"></code></pre>

<hr style="box-sizing: content-box; overflow: visible; margin: 2rem 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #eeebee; color: #5c5962;">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">Now that you have written functions for different steps of the model-building process, you will put it all together. <ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px;">

</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Important:</span> Conduct hyperparameter tuning locally or in a separate notebook. Avoid tuning within Gradescope to prevent autograder timeouts.

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Develop your own local tests to ensure your code functions correctly before submitting to Gradescope. <h2 id="train_model_return_scores_clamp-clamp-dataset" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 24px !important;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_model_return_scores_clamp</code> (ClaMP Dataset)</h2>
<h3 id="instructions-5-points" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Instructions (5 points):</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">This function focuses on training a model using the ClaMP dataset and evaluating its performance on a test set.

<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: none; counter-reset: step-counter 0; width: 1459px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Input:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_df</code>: A Pandas DataFrame containing the ClaMP training data. This includes the “label” column, which serves as your target variable (0 for benign, 1 for malicious).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>: A Pandas DataFrame containing the ClaMP test data. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">The “label” column is intentionally omitted from this set.</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Model Training:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Train a machine learning model using the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_df</code> dataset.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">You may use any techniques covered in this project.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Set a random seed for reproducibility.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Perform hyperparameter tuning (if needed) to optimize your model’s performance.
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Tip: putting comments on the ranges you select for hyperparameters will help the graders understand how you chose it</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Document your hyperparameter tuning strategy (if any) in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">document_hyperparameter_tuning_clamp</code> function. If you used grid search or some other automated search, running that function should generate the same parameters you used for your submission.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Prediction:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Use your trained model to predict the probability of malware for each row in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Output these probabilities as values between 0 and 1. A value closer to 0 indicates a lower likelihood of malware, while a value closer to 1 indicates a higher likelihood.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Output:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Return a Pandas DataFrame with two columns:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">index</code>: The index from the input <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">prob_label_1</code>: The predicted malware probabilities.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Evaluation:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">The autograder will evaluate your predictions using the ROC AUC score.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">You must achieve a ROC AUC score of 0.9 or higher on the test set to receive full credit.</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="local-test-case" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Local Test Case</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">For this task we do not provide a local test case for you. One of the Learning Objectives of this project is getting familiar using and creating python unittests. You have used tests we created for you in tasks 1-4 and now will get to practice creating your own.

<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: none; counter-reset: step-counter 0; width: 1459px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Load the training data you were provided in the Task5 folder from the CSV file.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Split that file into a train df and a test df (a common split % to use is 80% data for the train set and 20% for the test set). Review Task 2 and the scikit-learn docs for useful parameters to ensure a balanced split.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Make a copy of the test df with the label column removed to mimic the environment your model will see in the AG.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Run your train_model_return_scores function on those datasets to get your predictions</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Run the output checks:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Make sure the number of rows in your predictions matches the expected number of rows (compare with rows of your test set)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Check if the returned DataFrame has exactly the columns [“index”, “prob_label_1”]. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Hint</span>: DataFrame.columns returns the columns of a pandas DataFrame.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Calculate the ROC AUC score between your <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">prob_label_1</code> values and the true class labels (compare with the test set). You can use the thresholds described in the evaluation section above to determine whether your model “passes” this test.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

<h3 id="clamp-dataset" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">ClaMP Dataset</h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">The ClaMP (Classification of Malware with PE Headers) dataset is used for malware classification.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">It is based on the header fields of Portable Executable (PE) files.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Learn more about PE files:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/debug/pe-format">Microsoft – PE Format</a></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portable_Executable">Wikipedia – Portable Executable</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">ClaMP Dataset GitHub Repository: <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://github.com/urwithajit9/ClaMP">https://github.com/urwithajit9/ClaMP</a></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">This project uses the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">ClaMP_Raw-5184.csv</code> file (55 features).

</li>

<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Train a machine learning model using the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_df</code>.</li>

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Document your hyperparameter tuning strategy in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">document_hyperparameter_tuning_clamp</code> function. If you used grid search or some other automated search, running that function should generate the same parameters you used for your submission.</li>

</ul>
</li>

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Evaluation:</span>

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Parameter tuning will likely be necessary to achieve higher scores.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="local-test-case-1" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Local Test Case</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">For this task we do not provide a local test case for you. One of the Learning Objectives of this project is getting familiar using and creating python unittests. You have used tests we created for you in tasks 1-4 and now will get to practice creating your own.

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Split that file into a train df and a test df (a common split % to use is 80% data for the train set and 20% for the test set). <li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Make a copy of the test df with the label column removed to mimic the environment your model will see in the AG.</li>

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Run Output Checks:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Check if the returned DataFrame has exactly the columns [“index”, “prob_label_1”]. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Hint</span>: DataFrame.columns returns the columns of a pandas DataFrame.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Calculate the ROC AUC score between your <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">prob_label_1</code> values and the true class labels (compare with the test set). <h3 id="instructions-5-points-1" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Instructions (5 points):</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">This function focuses on training a model using the PhiUSIIL Phishing URL dataset and evaluating its performance on a test set. It will likely require exploring and understanding the dataset, feature creation, data preprocessing, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning to achieve full credit.

<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: none; counter-reset: step-counter 0; width: 1459px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Input:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_df</code>: A Pandas DataFrame containing the PhiUSIIL Phishing URL training data (including the “label” column).</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>: A Pandas DataFrame containing the PhiUSIIL Phishing URL test data (<span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">without</span> the “label” column).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Model Training:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">You will need to create your own feature engineering functions to pass this task since you are only given a single text column. Review resources for tips on generating features from a URL.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Train a machine learning model using the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">train_df</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">You can use any techniques from this project.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Set a random seed for reproducibility.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Document your hyperparameter tuning strategy (if any) in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">document_hyperparameter_tuning_clamp</code> function. If you used grid search or some other automated search, running that function should generate the same parameters you used for your submission.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Prediction:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Predict the probability of label=1 for each row in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Output probabilities between 0 and 1, where values closer to 1 indicate a higher likelihood of being label=1.</li>
</ul>

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Output:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Return a Pandas DataFrame with two columns:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1411px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">index</code>: The index from the input <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">test_df</code>.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">prob_label_1</code>: The predicted probabilities of label=1.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Evaluation:</span>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">The autograder will evaluate your predictions using the ROC AUC score.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Full Credit (5 points) will be given for 0.85 and above, 2.5 points for .8 and above and 1.25 points for .55 and above</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Parameter tuning will likely be necessary to achieve higher scores.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="local-test-case-2" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">Local Test Case</h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-bottom: 1em; color: #000000 !important;">For this task we do not provide a local test case for you. One of the Learning Objectives of this project is getting familiar using and creating python unittests. You have used tests we created for you in tasks 1-4 and now will get to practice creating your own.

<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style-type: none; counter-reset: step-counter 0; width: 1459px;">

<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Split that file into a train df and a test df (a common split % to use is 80% data for the train set and 20% for the test set). Review Task 2 and the scikit-learn docs for useful parameters to ensure a balanced split.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Make a copy of the test df with the label column removed to mimic the environment your model will see in the AG.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Run your train_model_return_scores function on those datasets to get your predictions</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; position: relative; color: #000000 !important;">Run Output Checks:
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1435px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Make sure the number of rows in your predictions matches the expected number of rows (compare with rows of your test set)</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Check if the returned DataFrame has exactly the columns [“index”, “prob_label_1”]. <span style="box-sizing: border-box; font-weight: bolder;">Hint</span>: DataFrame.columns returns the columns of a pandas DataFrame.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px;">Calculate the ROC AUC score between your <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SFMono-Regular, menlo, consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.4; padding: 0.2em 0.15em; background-color: #f5f6fa; border: 1px solid #eeebee; border-radius: 4px; overflow-x: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #000000 !important;">prob_label_1</code> values and the true class labels (compare with the test set). You can use the thresholds described in the evaluation section above to determine whether your model “passes” this test.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

<h3 id="phiusiil-phishing-url-dataset" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; line-height: 1.25; position: relative; color: #000000 !important; font-size: 18px !important;">PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset</h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5em; padding-left: 1.5em; list-style: none; width: 1459px;">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">The PhiUSIIL Phishing URL dataset was created from 235,795 legitimate and phishing urls. For our class we are only giving you the URLs and want you to feature engineer your own predictive features to use in an ML model. This task is open ended meaning you should do your own research to determine what features to generate from a url. You can try to mimic the features the authors created or create your own the only limitation is your features need to be created from the URL alone (without internet access) so more complex strategies that try to scrape the url will not work in the autograder.</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Dataset Website: <a style="box-sizing: border-box; background-color: transparent; color: #7253ed; text-decoration: underline #eeebee; text-underline-offset: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0167404823004558?via%3Dihub">PhiUSIIL: A diverse security profile empowered phishing URL detection framework based on similarity index and incremental learning</a></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.25em 0px; color: #000000 !important;">Note: This project does not use all features or classes from the original PhiUSIIL Phishing URL dataset.</li>
</ul>
